board.name: Oklahoma State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision (Physician Assistant Advisory Committee)

licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA) licence
licence.renewalDeadline: March 31 each year (licence year April 1 to March 31); late renewal with late fee April 1 to May 31; after May 31 treated as a new application

ce.categoryRules: 20 hours Category I CME per calendar year; Category I hours sponsored or approved by state and national associations accepted automatically; deficient licensees must obtain 40 hours Category I the next calendar year

topicMandates.appliesTo: all PAs (each calendar year, Category I)

topicMandates.topic: Pain management or opioid use or addiction (statutory)
topicMandates.appliesTo: all PAs; 59 O.S. § 519.8(A). Separate from the rule's 1 hour substance abuse; whether one opioid addiction hour satisfies both is not stated.

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: Each calendar year: 1 hour Category I on substance abuse (OAC 435:15-3-17(b)) and, by statute, 1 hour on pain management or opioid use/addiction (59 O.S. § 519.8(A)); both within the 20 hours. Whether a single opioid addiction hour satisfies both is not stated.
ce.firstRenewalExemption: exempt from reporting CME until one year after initial licensure

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Form 5 practice agreement with each delegating physician filed with the Medical Board within 10 business days of execution and of every change (delegating physician, practice address, method of supervision); no filing fee; no fixed renewal date. Optional once the PA has 6,240 verified postgraduate clinical hours (Form 6) and practices independently.
practice.notes: HB 2584 (2025), effective Aug 29, 2025. Independent PAs must carry malpractice cover of $1,000,000 per occurrence / $3,000,000 aggregate. Delegating physician limited to six supervised PAs/APRNs with exceptions (OAC 435:10-13-2). An annual jurisprudence item and other renewal changes are in rules adopted Sept 24, 2026 with anticipated effective date summer 2027 (not yet in force).

prescribing.stateCsRegistrationName: Oklahoma Bureau of Narcotics and Dangerous Drugs Control (OBNDD) registration (63 O.S. § 2-302)
prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No separate board prescriptive registration; Schedule II only under a current Form 5 practice agreement listing prescribing scope, tied to each practice address. Independent PAs (no practice agreement) may prescribe Schedules III to V only.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: Each calendar year: 1 hour Category I on substance abuse (OAC 435:15-3-17(b)) and, by statute, 1 hour on pain management or opioid use/addiction (59 O.S. § 519.8(A)); both within the 20 hours. Whether a single opioid addiction hour satisfies both is not stated.

facts.quote: Licenses issued to physician assistants shall be renewed annually on a date determined by the State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision.

facts.quote: An application for renewal shall be submitted not later than March 31 of each calendar year.
facts.note: Same text in the LII copy of current OAC 435:15-3-1(b)(5)(C) and in the 2027 redline (relettered only, wording unchanged).

facts.value: April 1 to May 31 with late fee; after May 31 initial application

facts.note: Statute 59 O.S. § 519.8(A) also requires 20 hours in the preceding calendar year.

facts.quote: At least one (1) hour of Category I CME shall be earned each calendar year concerning the topic of substance abuse.

facts.value: 6 PAs/APRNs, with exceptions
facts.quote: No physician shall supervise more than a total of six (6) physician assistants and/or advanced practice registered nurses regarding their prescriptive authority.

facts.quote: education shall include not less than one (1) hour of education in pain management or one (1) hour of education in opioid use or addiction.

rn.renewalDeadline: last day of birth month in even numbered years
rn.ceHoursPerCycle: 24 contact hours is one of several options: 520 work hours, 24 contact hours of CE, current nursing specialty certification, Board approved refresher course, or 6 academic semester credit hours, within the 2 years before expiry

aprn.title: APRN-CNP (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse, Certified Nurse Practitioner)
aprn.renewalDeadline: concurrent with the RN renewal (even numbered years, end of birth month)
aprn.ceNote: No APRN specific CE hour total; national certification must be current and maintained. CE hours below attach to prescriptive authority.
aprn.pharmacologyHoursPerCycle: 15 contact hours (or 1 academic credit hour) pharmacotherapeutics per 2 years for supervised prescriptive authority; independent prescriptive authority instead needs 40 hours Category I CME per 2 years

topicMandates.topic: Pain management OR opioid use or addiction
topicMandates.appliesTo: APRNs renewing prescriptive authority who hold a federal DEA registration

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Yes: Prescriptive Authority Recognition from the Board of Nursing, separate for each APRN role/specialty certification, renewed with the RN and APRN licence. Independent Prescriptive Authority (HB 2298, eff. Nov 1, 2025) is a separate initial application after 6,240 supervised prescribing hours.
prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: 15 contact hours pharmacotherapeutics in the 2 years before renewal (supervised prescriptive authority); not required at the first renewal within 24 months of initial approval. Independent prescriptive authority: 40 hours Category I CME in 2 years.
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 2 hours pain management or opioid use/addiction per renewal if holding a DEA registration
prescribing.stateCsRegistrationName: OBNDD registration plus DEA before prescribing Schedules III to V (APRNs may not prescribe Schedule II; 30 day supply limit)

practice.authorityNote: Classification is derived: physician supervision is required only for prescriptive authority until independent prescriptive authority is granted (6,240 hours).
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Agreement for Physician Supervising Advanced Practice Prescriptive Authority (notarized) on file with the Board of Nursing for every supervising physician; at each renewal a signed supervising physician statement on availability is required (not needed if one was filed within 90 days before expiry). Medical Board rule: supervision agreement filed within 30 calendar days of any supervision change. Not required once independent prescriptive authority is granted. Board of Nursing rule: changes to the supervising physician written statement filed within 30 days of the change (OAC 485:10-16-5(b)).
